## Checklist

- [ ] I read the style rules in STYLEGUIDE.md.
- [ ] I updated `last_reviewed` on any file I substantively edited (not needed for typo fixes).
- [ ] If a file I changed has `status: locked`, I named the reviewing domain owner in this PR body.
- [ ] If I added a quotation, it reproduces the cited instrument's published text exactly, and I linked the source.
- [ ] My commits carry a DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
